Power Stations | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This 
 document outlines the equipment inspection list I1, which must be performed 
 on a weekly bases as indicated by W1 in the above titled block.
This compressor serves in compressing air for 
 self-cleaning system which is using in cleaning the Gas Turbine GT air filters and HRSG 
 'Heat Recovery Steam Generator' inlet damper to control opening and closing.
The first 
 draft is initiated by eng. Saad Samra, tested by eng. Mohamed Abdel Azeem, 
 revised by EDEPC. 
 inspection and quality control eng Abouda Elbanna and accepted by General 
 manager eng. Mohamed Elsarrag and approved by eng. Moneer Mahmoud 
 El-Wakeel; Head Sector of Damietta PS.
Technical 
specification
 | Type of the 
 compressor | : | Atlas Copco GA 
 345-10
 | Max. unloading Pressure | : | 9 bars .
 | Min working 
 pressure | : | 4 bars.
 | Max inlet 
 temperature | : | 30 C .
 | Motor shaft 
 speed | : | 2955 r.p.m.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued and the qualified maintenance staff should 
 carry the suitable safety category.
Safety fence 
 with caution marks surrounding the work area.
Wear safety 
 helmet, shoes.
A work permit must be issued and the qualified maintenance staff should 
 carry the suitable safety category.
Safety fence 
 with caution marks surrounding the work area.
Wear safety 
 helmet, shoes.
Disconnect the power supply of 
 the compressor.
Isolate the compressor 
 mechanically.
Tools and Equipment
Complete maintenance tool set.
Compressed air hose.
Cleaning articles (fluid, rags etc).
Soft brushes..
Spray gun.
Work to be Carried Out
Check for oil leaks.
Check the oil level and add oil if it is required.
Clean unit by air jet.
Remove small air filter element and clean it by air jet if necessary.
